gui/vendor/qrcode.js bundles "QRCode for JavaScript" for offline, in-browser
QR rendering (no CDN / no internet access needed on the kiosk machine).

  QRCode for JavaScript
  Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
  URL: http://www.d-project.com/
  Licensed under the MIT license:
    http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php

  The word "QR Code" is a registered trademark of
  DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED
    http://www.denso-wave.com/qrcode/faqpatent-e.html

The individual source modules were originally repackaged for Node.js by the
"qrcode-terminal" project (Apache-2.0 wrapper around this MIT-licensed core;
https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal) and were re-bundled here, algorithm
unmodified, into a single browser-loadable script exposing a `window.qrcode`
constructor, so DMMS never has to fetch a QR library from a CDN at runtime.
